resources.string: With your explicit permission, this companion receives window-change metadata to show its assistant only while the official PayPal app is foregrounded. It reads accessible text only from that app for local rule-based screen classification. It does not save or upload screen text, click controls, or perform payments. Disable it anytime in Accessibility settings.

Privacy first: with your permission, Saathi receives window-change metadata to show its independent assistant only over the official PayPal app. Accessible text from PayPal is used transiently on-device for screen classification and is not saved or uploaded. Only the detected category and a question you submit are sent to your configured Saathi server. Saathi does not click payment buttons or make payments. Never share passwords, PINs, OTPs, or card details. Verify recipient, amount, and fees in PayPal yourself.

Before Android opens Accessibility settings, Saathi explains that the service receives window-change metadata across apps to detect when PayPal is foregrounded, but reads accessible screen text only from the official PayPal app. Enable “PayPal Saathi AI Screen Monitor” only if you agree. To stop monitoring, disable that service.

With your permission, Saathi receives window-change metadata across apps so it can show the assistant only while the official PayPal app is foregrounded. It reads accessible text only from that PayPal app, uses the text transiently for local screen classification, and never saves or uploads screen text. The detected category is stored on this device and may be sent with a question you submit to your configured Saathi server. The floating panel is an independent overlay, is not part of PayPal, and may cover part of the screen; minimize it before using any PayPal control. Saathi does not click controls or make payments. You can disable the service in Accessibility settings at any time.
